scope: prospective rules, not a preregistered compatibility label or native qualification

sources.binding_requirement: Actual full commit/tree/wheel/installed/source subjects and immutable config must be retained by runner; short Host label is not a qualification pin

independence.postlaunch_rule_is_not_claimed_prelaunch: Runner must independently join these freeze clocks/bytes to each actual Popen; any group already started before this freeze is prior-rule/unregistered and cannot be retroactively promoted

required: exact served-model and unique original RID joined to original request and HTTP response
on-time successful HTTP response with nonempty output; actual usage and actual decode length retained
actual Host/API/Engine/TP0/TP1 epochs and terminal cleanup independently captured
functional_support.failure: known HTTP/model/RID/deadline/cleanup errors are failures, never hidden by successful metadata

required: studyloader records actual metadata target and exact callable invocation order
all groups use same source-owned studyloader; no duplicated automatic entrypoint invocation
singletons actually activate their own native paths; observed load is distinct from effect
loading.not_proof: entrypoint returns, configuration, health200, and MOD enabled/log text are not effect proofs

required_when_KV_present: raw scheduler transaction binds original RID and semantic anchor to 1024 physical anchor
two distinct original TP ranks ACK the same actual transaction/anchors
independent original Host EventBus RequestFinished.kv_blocks joined to original RID/epoch/HTTP usage, with field semantics and observation timing established from pinned Host source
independent physical allocation/block-table or native runtime result supports the claimed physical quantity; do not relabel semantic/logical counters as physical storage

same observation point and source-defined accounting in host-only/profiler-only/KV-only/pair controls; derive expected blocks from actual block size and actual post-anchor decoding, not a hard-coded count
unknown_if: threshold not reached or no actual transaction
RequestFinished.kv_blocks missing, timing/meaning unproven, or lacking independent physical result
physical counter compared at different lifecycle points
known_failure: different/missing rank at an asserted completed transaction
independent physical result contradicts asserted transaction

required_when_profiler_present: actual process-owned trace request_finished and reclaimed/lifecycle closure joined to the original Host event/RID/HTTP request
no loss/error/dropped records in the declared finite window
unknown_if: event never triggered or raw trace/Host correlation absent
failure_if: substituted epoch/RID or duplicate coverage represented as complete

pass_requires: both appropriate singletons establish the intended bounded effects
each of the two actual load orders preserves both independently established effects under matched inputs
functional support and independently verified cleanup pass for all evaluated groups
composition.unknown_if: either required effect untriggered/unknown or common tuple/singletons not established
composition.failure_if: a known valid singleton effect is lost or contradicted in pair, or a known functional/ownership/cleanup violation occurs
not_proved: device/native execution from CPU/source logs alone

record_separately: studyloader source/LOC and actual call bookkeeping
per-group configuration, actual human effort or unknown, builds, installs, all failed attempts
